creativity.reason: Level 0: the business description covers pharmaceutical and medical product distribution, manufacturing and services and shows no creative activity.

community.reason: Level 2: the filing describes only employee development (skill, learning, manager and safety training) and no external education or community investment, so the score is capped at 2.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 0: the human capital section is substantive but describes no inclusion practices, accessibility or multilingual services, or community-connecting programs, and international operations alone do not count.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: the company serves independent drug stores and physician practices as customers but describes no specific program aimed at barriers to starting or growing a business.

evidence.activity: Company-wide employee skill development, learning and manager development under the talent management strategy
evidence.quote: This approach includes broad based employee skill development and learning and manager development.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Management > Talent Management and Learning

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size (cap)

evidence.activity: Role-specific safety training for workers, with training modules updated as processes change
evidence.quote: Our workers receive specialized training related to their role, work setting, and equipment used in their work environment.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Management > Worker Health & Safety

community.criterion: level 2: employee development (safety training, supporting only; cap applies)

evidence.activity: Distributes pharmaceuticals and consumer health products to retailers, including independent drug stores
evidence.quote: distributes branded and generic pharmaceutical and over-the-counter healthcare and consumer products to retailers (including chain and independent drug stores and pharmacy departments of supermarkets and mass merchandisers), hospitals, and other healthcare providers;
evidence.section: Item 1 > Business > Pharmaceutical and Specialty Solutions Segment

entrepreneurship.criterion: level 1: small-business customers (independent drug stores) with no specific enabling service

notes: The human capital section points to the Sustainable Business Report and 2026 Proxy Statement for more information. Coverage is still sufficient because the section is well over 150 words and describes specific activities itself (employee skill development, engagement surveys, safety training), so no second look is triggered. Traps excluded: 'copyright' in Intellectual Property (IP protection, not creative work); 'design' in regulatory requirements (device engineering); 'Sourcing Venture' with CVS Health (joint venture); 'community health centers' and 'independent community oncology network' (healthcare sites and acquisitions, not community investment). Pharmacies operated in community health centers were not credited for Cross-cultural customer access because the filing calls them a 'limited number' and does not say they serve underserved groups. MSO support services to physician practices go with the acquisitions of those practices and were not treated as an enabling program. The Item 7 excerpts repeat the Item 1 segment description and add no new qualifying activities. E2 is safety training, close to required compliance training; it supports E1 only and does not change the capped level.
